decisions.reason: The accelerator program is peripheral to the core recycling machinery business and uses scarce slack in a small, cash-constrained firm, but it is cheap to run, still featured on the home page, and supports the firm's partner network, so it is likely kept for now despite a real risk of pruning.

The bio-based bitumen binder is presented as a flagship with its own page and signals strategic commitment, yet it is far from the core machinery competence and its market results are uncertain, so it carries moderate drop risk if aspirations are not met.

The WASTX Cleanic is close to the core offer, backed by an industrial partner (ERMAFA), and featured as a flagship on the home page in both years, so management will keep it while results are still emerging.
